book.name: Yoohana
book.title: Amangʼana Amazʉmu ga Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ chɨmbu gaandikirwɨ na Yoohana

content: Ekerenjo chu umuriisha umwerya we ekoro
Yɨɨsu akangʼeha kʉgamba, “Nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra amaheene, ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ atakusikɨra kʉhɨtɨra mukishoko cha ribhanza rya zɨngʼʉndu, nawe arasikɨrɨra ahandɨ, wuyo ni‑mwibhi na mʉsaakuri.
Nawe wʉnʉ akusikɨra kʉhɨtɨra mukishoko cha ribhanza, wuyo ni‑muriisha wa zɨngʼʉndu.
Umuriibhi wa ribhanza aramushʉkʉrɨra ikishoko, na zɨngʼʉndu zihiigwa riraka ryu umuriisha. Ahaabhɨrɨkɨra ɨngʼʉndu yɨmwɨ yɨmwɨ iriina ryazɨ na kʉzɨkangata kuja igʉtʉ.
Hanʉ ahaamara kuhurucha zɨngʼʉndu zaazɨ igʉtʉ, ahaakangata mʉbhʉtangɨ, zʉʉsi zɨhaamutuna, kʉ kʉbha zɨɨzɨ riraka ryazɨ.
Zɨngʼʉndu zɨtakʉtʉra kutuna umugini, nawe zɨhaamuryara, kʉ kʉbha zɨtɨɨzɨ riraka ryazɨ.”
Yɨɨsu akabhabhʉʉrɨra Abhafarisaayo ekerenjo kɨnʉ, nawe ebho bhatʉʉbhʉʉrirɨ ganʉ aarɨ akʉbhabhʉʉrɨra.
Mmbe, Yɨɨsu akabhabhʉʉrɨra naatu, “Nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra amaheene, inyɨ niinyɨ ikishoko kɨnʉ zɨngʼʉndu zɨhaahɨtɨra kusikɨra mwibhanza.
Bhʉʉsi bhanʉ bhankangatiirɨ kʉbha abhariisha bha zɨngʼʉndu, bhaarɨ abhiibhi na abhasaakuri, nawe zɨngʼʉndu zɨtabhiitɨgɨɨrɨɨrɨ.
Inyɨ niinyɨ ikishoko kiyo. Wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ akusikɨra mwibhanza kʉhɨtɨra kwa niinyɨ arasabhurwa, na arabha nu umweya kusikɨra na kʉhʉrʉka, na kuja kuriisha mukiriishʉ ɨkɨzʉmu.
Umwibhi ahaaza mwibhanza korereke iibhɨ zɨngʼʉndu na kuziita na kʉsarya. Nawe inyɨ niizirɨ korereke zɨbhɨ nʉ ʉbhʉhʉru, na zɨbhɨ nabhwɨ bhwaru.
“Inyɨ niinyɨ umuriisha ʉmʉzʉmu. Umuriisha ʉmʉzʉmu ahaahurucha ʉbhʉhʉru bhwazɨ igʉrʉ wa zɨngʼʉndu zaazɨ.
Omohocha wʉnʉ atarɨ umuriisha wa zɨngʼʉndu na zɨngʼʉndu zɨtarɨ zaazɨ, araarore isuuzɨ ɨraaza, ahaaryara na kutiga zɨngʼʉndu izeene. Kʉgayo, isuuzɨ ɨraryarɨra zɨngʼʉndu na kʉzɨnyaraganʼya.
Omohocha ahaaryara, kʉ kʉbha atakʉdɨɨrɨɨra zɨngʼʉndu ziyo.
“Inyɨ niinyɨ umuriisha ʉmʉzʉmu. Nɨɨzɨ bhwaheene zɨngʼʉndu zaanɨ, zʉʉsi zɨɨnyɨzɨ,
chɨmburya Bhaabha anyɨzɨ inyɨ, na niinyɨ nimwɨzɨ. Inyɨ nɨrahurucha ʉbhʉhʉru bhwanɨ igʉrʉ wa zɨngʼʉndu zaanɨ.
Inyɨ nɨna zɨngʼʉndu ɨzɨndɨ zɨnʉ zɨtarɨ za mwibhanza rɨnʉ, zʉʉsi nereenderwa niziriishɨ. Zɨngʼʉndu ziyo zʉʉsi, zɨramenya riraka ryanɨ. Akʉmara rɨrabha riribhita rɨmwɨ, nu umuriisha wʉmwɨ.
“Bhaabha ansɨɨgirɨ, kʉ kʉbha nɨrahurucha ʉbhʉhʉru bhwanɨ, korereke nebhogege naatu.

Atareeho ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ akʉtʉra kunduusha ʉbhʉhʉru bhwanɨ. Niinyɨ inyimwene nikuhurucha ʉbhʉhʉru bhwanɨ. Nɨnʉ ʉbhʉnaja bhwu kuhurucha ʉbhʉhʉru bhwanɨ, na nɨnʉ ʉbhʉnaja bhwo okogega ʉbhʉhʉru kwikɨ. Nɨ‑Bhaabha umwene wʉnʉ answajiryɨ kokorabhu.”
Hanʉ bhiigwirɨ amangʼana gayo, Abhayaahudi bhakataamanʼya abheene kobheene.
Bhaaru gatɨ waabhʉ bhakabhuga, “Wʉnʉ ana risambwa! Na nɨ‑mʉsazi! Kwakɨ mʉramwitegeerera?”
Nawe abhandɨ bhakabhuga, “Amangʼana gayo gatakurwa kʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ ana risambwa. Nangʉ, risambwa rɨratʉra kokora ʉmʉhʉku arore?”
Abhaatʉ bhaaru bharaanga Yɨɨsu
Mmbe, Yɨrusarɨɨmu iyo, kwarɨ ni isigukuru ya Abhayaahudi yu ukuhiita kʉbha rihekaaru rya Mungu rɨkabhɨngukibhwa na kwigurwa naatu. Ribhaga riyo, ryarɨ rye embeho.
Yɨɨsu aarɨ aragenda mwihekaaru, ʉrʉbhaara rʉnʉ rukubhirikirwa, Rigoobhe rya Sɨrɨmaani.
Abhayaahudi abhandɨ bhakamwiruguura, bhakamubhuurya, “Nangʉ, ʉratʉnyaacha mozekoro zɨɨtʉ kuhika ryʉrɨ? Arɨɨbhɨ naawɨ Kiriisitʉ, ʉtʉbhʉʉrɨrɨ habhwɨrʉ.”
Nawe Yɨɨsu akabhagarukirya, “Inyɨ nɨmarirɨ kʉbhabhʉʉrɨrabhu, nawe imwɨ mʉtakwisirirya. Emeremo gɨnʉ nɨrakora kʉbhʉnaja bhwa Bhaabha, nejo gekomenyeekererya kʉbha inyɨ nɨ‑wɨɨwɨ.
Nawe mʉtakwenda kunyiisirirya, kʉ kʉbha imwɨ mʉtarɨ zɨngʼʉndu zaanɨ.
Zɨngʼʉndu zaanɨ zihiigwa riraka ryanɨ. Inyɨ nɨzɨɨzɨ, zʉʉsi zɨhaantuna.
Inyɨ nɨrazeha ʉbhʉhʉru bhwa kemerano, na zɨtakurimɨra. Na atareeho ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ akʉtʉra kʉzɨsaakʉra kurwa mʉmabhoko gaanɨ.
Bhaabha waanɨ angʼɨɨrɨ zɨngʼʉndu ziyo, ewe newe ʉmʉkʉrʉ kʉkɨra bhʉʉsi. Na atareeho ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ akʉtʉra kʉzɨsaakʉra mʉmabhoko gaazɨ.
Inyɨ na Bhaabha kegero kɨmwɨ tʉrɨ.”
Hayo neho Abhayaahudi bhaatʉʉrirɨ amabhwɨ naatu, korereke bhamoteme nagʉ na kumwita.
Nawe Yɨɨsu akabhabhʉʉrɨra, “Nɨbhɨɨrɨkiryɨ emeremo ɨmɨzʉmu gɨnʉ nakʉrirɨ kʉmanaga ga Bhaabha. Ni‑ngʼanakɨ rɨnʉ rɨkʉbhakora imwɨ mwende kontema na amabhwɨ?”
Abhayaahudi bhakagarukirya, “Tʉtakwenda kokotema amabhwɨ igʉrʉ wo okokora emeremo ɨmɨzʉmu, nawe kʉ kʉbha ʉrarega Mungu, kwa kwikorya kʉbha awɨ ni‑Mungu, ɨnʉ awɨ nɨ‑mʉʉtʉbhu ncha abhandɨ!”
Yɨɨsu akabhabhuurya, “Nangʉ, ɨkɨɨrɨ kwandɨkwa mʉMaandɨkʉ gaanyu gi imigirʉ kʉbha Mungu aagambirɨ, ‘Imwɨ nɨ‑mɨsambwa’?
Amaandɨkʉ Amarɨndu gatakʉtʉra kwichʉra. Arɨɨbhɨ Mungu akabhɨrɨkɨra abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhasʉngʼaanirɨ ɨngʼana yaazɨ nɨ‑mɨsambwa,
nangʉ, kwakɨ mʉrabhuga, nɨratʉka Mungu hanʉ nikubhuga, ‘Inyɨ ni‑Mwana wa Mungu’? Inyɨ wʉnʉ Bhaabha aambɨngukiryɨ na kʉntʉma kʉʉsɨ kʉnʉ.
Arɨɨbhɨ nɨtakokora emeremo ja Bhaabha, mʉtanyiisirirya.
Nawe arɨɨbhɨ nɨrakora emeremo ja Bhaabha, nangabha mʉtakunyiisirirya inyɨ, mmbe mwisiriryɨ emeremo giyo. Neho mokomenya, Bhaabha arɨ kwa niinyɨ, na niinyɨ nɨrɨ kwa Bhaabha.”
Hanʉ Abhayaahudi bhiigwirɨ amangʼana gayo, bhakeenda kumugwata kwikɨ, nawe Yɨɨsu akasʉsʉbhʉka mʉmabhoko gaabhʉ.
Mmbe, Yɨɨsu akaja imwambʉkʉ wɨ ɨkɨtaarʉ cha Yorodaani, akahika hanʉ Yoohana aarɨ arabhatiiza abhaatʉ. Akiikara iyo sikʉ suuhu.
Abhaatʉ bhaaru bhakamuuzaku, bhakabhuga, “Yoohana ataakʉrirɨ ichɨrɨkɨnʼyʉ nʉʉrʉ kɨmwɨ, nawe amangʼana gʉʉsi ganʉ aarɨ aragamba igʉrʉ wa Yɨɨsu, gaarɨ ga amaheene.”
Abhaatʉ bhaaru bhanʉ bhaareho, bhakiisirirya Yɨɨsu.
